Faction.name: {=gwp_clan_name}Grey Wardens
Faction.text: {=gwp_clan_description}The Grey Wardens began as an order within the Imperial priesthood, charged with patrol and punishment. After the Empire fractured, they broke from the rule of its lords but continued to bind themselves and others to Heaven's commandments. Women command the order, priests preach its faith, and village congregations supply recruits and provisions. They pursue raiders and protect villages and trade routes, regarding punishment as a religious duty. The common folk rely on their protection and fear the severity of their judgment.
